answer_1.quote: Text summarization aims to automatically generate a fluent and succinct summary for a given text document ... We evaluate our model on three representative benchmark datasets. Results show that GEMINI allows the model to better fit training data ...

answer_2.quote: We report automatic metric ROUGE-1/2/L ... As Table shows, we evaluate our model on three benchmark datasets, in comparison with other BART-based models ... We report automatic metric ROUGE-1/2/L.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation to quantitatively measure the quality of generated summaries. ... We compare GEMINI with BART and BART-Rewriter baselines, studying four qualities, including informativeness, conciseness, readability, and faithfulness. We hire three graduate students ... to annotate each candidate summary from 1 (worst) to 5 (best).
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated each generated summary on informativeness, conciseness, readability, and faithfulness on a 1‑5 scale.
